notes.content:

notes.title: Super Rolling Heroes Deluxe - New demo now available on Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Play the new Super Rolling Heroes Deluxe demo at Steam Next Fest![/b]
[/h3]
Super Rolling Heroes Deluxe is rolling into this special event with an exciting demo! Play through a unique selection of levels and experience fast-paced downhill platforming like never before. Can you collect all the gold medals?

Don't forget to add Super Rolling Heroes Deluxe to your Steam Wishlist!
